name: Les Llosses (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly, green above and yellow below, with two yellow ladles in saltire at the upper hoist.
history: The flag was published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya on 3 November 1995; it is an oblong flag of 2:3 with, next to the staff, two yellow ladles crossed in saltire over the diagonals of an imaginary square of half the height, separated from the corner by 1/18; the ladles are canting arms referring to the name of the locality.

features.role: two ladles (llosses) in saltire at the upper hoist, the canting figures
